text:
Anna (AE): Heads up — AcmeFin wants to run a 2-week POC next week. Primary asks: SSO (SAML + IdP-initiated), SCIM provisioning, fine-grained RBAC (team-level roles), and domain ownership proof for tenant separation. They also dropped a 50-question security questionnaire and asked for a pricing estimate for ~50 users with burst to 5000 req/day. Need quick sync before my call with their IT at 10:30 PT tomorrow.

Sam (SE): Got it. Quick answers: we support SAML SP- and IdP-initiated flows, SCIM v2 for users/groups, and RBAC with custom roles scoped per tenant. There are a couple of SCIM attribute mapping caveats for company-specific attributes (employeeNumber / costCenter) — we usually map with a custom mapping script during onboarding.

Anna (AE): @Sam can you confirm the minimal evidence we can share for their security questionnaire? they asked for diagrams + SOC2 attestation + KMS details.

Dave (Legal): We can share SOC2 Type II summary and our standard security pack. KMS: we support customer-managed keys in Private, hosted uses Redwood-managed keys (we provide key rotation details). For POC we can redact sensitive operational runbooks. 

Maya (Solutions): For the SCIM gap — if they have custom attributes we don't store out of the box, we can add mappings while keeping the user UUID stable. Example mapping snippet we use for onboarding:

```
scim_mappings:
  external: employee_id
  local: user.metadata.employeeNumber
```

Maya (Solutions): Also RBAC: we can create roles like `billing_admin`, `model_ops`, `viewer` scoped to their org ID; enforce at token-level.

Claire (Sales Ops): Pricing ask — for a 2-week POC with ~50 active seats and expected burst to 5k req/day, suggest drafting: hosted trial credit + a short Dedicated eval quote (monthly pro-rata). @Anna I can draft two numbers: (A) Hosted API (pay-as-you-go + $X credit) (B) Dedicated short-term reserve with pro-rata minimum. Need their expected throughput in tokens/second to firm the Dedicated quote.

Anna (AE): AcmeFin says typical convo model use: 60k tokens/day steady, 400k tokens/day peak. They're strict on domain ownership — they want domain verification and tenant isolation proof. Any docs?

Sam (SE): For domain verification we require DNS TXT ownership on their domain; we can provide the exact TXT and expiry policy. Tenant isolation: we can provide architecture diagram showing VPC + network ACLs for Private, and logical tenant separation details for Hosted/Dedicated. I can paste a small diagram link in the pack.

Dave (Legal): Note: they'll ask about data retention / deletion for POC. Default hosted retention is 30 days for request metadata; embeddings/auth logs retention varies. We should propose a short POC retention SLA and include deletion steps. I'll add standard wording.

Maya (Solutions): Action items I can take: (1) produce SCIM attribute mapping checklist, (2) RBAC role template + example policies, (3) short architecture diagram for tenant isolation. Will need an example domain to craft TXT sample.

Claire (Sales Ops): I'll prepare two draft quotes and a short POC SOW template (2 weeks, objectives, success criteria, support hours). Need lead time: who owns the SOW? @Anna

Anna (AE): I own SOW. Please cc me when you draft. Sam — can you pop the mini-architecture diagram and a sample SCIM mapping by 9am PT tomorrow? Dave — can you sign off on the security pack redactions by EOD?

infra-bot: Deploy ticket #INF-487 created for sample diagram hosting (expires in 7 days).

Sam (SE): Yep — I'll send the SCIM JSON mapping + diagram link by 08:45 PT.

Dave (Legal): Will review and mark items for redaction. If they require customer-managed keys for POC, legal will need the contract addendum — flag early.

Anna (AE): Great. Last note: they asked about whether SCIM provisioning can be one-way initially (IdP -> Redwood) and later switched to two-way. Confirmed?

Maya (Solutions): Yes — we support one-way SCIM provisioning for POC and can enable two-way sync in Dedicated/Private with additional delta handling. Add to SOW.

Anna (AE): Perfect. Thanks everyone — I'll run the call and follow up with the checklist. :thumbsup:
